Tooltip_foodWorks_Preserves_Sealed: Sealed preserve. Open from the inventory menu before eating. Ingredients retain their relative age.
Tooltip_foodWorks_Preserves_Opened: Opened preserve. Eat normally or use in vanilla food preparation. Returns an empty jar when finished.
Tooltip_foodWorks_Preserves_Pulp: Edible pulp left after straining jelly. Perishable; fruit nutrients were split between this and the jelly.
